verdict.rationale: Dropbox publishes API reference documentation, including pages for content hash, webhooks and OAuth, plus a Dropbox Sign operation reference, and its JS SDK shows code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable, in-browser examples, and the OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable in-docs examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
